thread:
sam: Noticing sporadic mTLS handshake resets between ap-south and eu-west after the midnight keystore role pruning. Proxies in ap-south report `unwrap: access denied` in rotator agent and the negotiated cipher sometimes falls back to AES_128.

yara: Which role pruning? I merged the keystore tidy PR (no decrypt change) but maybe the keystore replication patch touched ARNs.

sam: Logs show: `rotator: kms_decrypt: AccessDenied: principal proxy-ap-south@project` and `tls: session-ticket empty -> fallback entropy low`.

ops-oncall: Quick checks: 1) iam-simulate for proxy SA against regional key 2) check keystore replicator logs for recent failures 3) enable extra audit for KMS decrypts in ap-south.

yara: iam-simulate -> Deny for `kms:Decrypt` on the ap-south key but Allowed for eu-west key. So replication + role scoping mismatch. PR removed broad wildcard ARN and left eu-west-grant only.

rotator-bot: [alert] 2025-03-17T00:12:34Z - handshake-reset-spike - 31 resets in 8m. Incident queued.

sam: Impact: short-lived clients drop and retries spike; p95 latency up ~180ms on affected routes. Not fully degraded but noisy.

ops-oncall: Mitigation: temporarily add scoped `kms:Decrypt` for proxy-ap-south principal to ap-south key; schedule keystore replicator fix to publish correct ARNs; add a deploy gate to run live unwrap across all regions for RBAC diffs.

yara: I'll patch the IAM binding and push audit logging for 6h. Also open ENGSEC ticket for replicator ARN validation.

sam: After IAM patch, re-run probe: `Cipher: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384`, `Session-Ticket: present (len=384)`, no unwrap errors. Good.

ops-oncall: Followups: 1) rotator team to add unit+integration tests for scoped ARNs 2) infra to add CI check: for any keystore RBAC change, run iam-simulate + live unwrap per-region 3) reduce severity on low-entropy fallback logs to avoid pager storms.

yara: Will attach PR diff, CloudTrail snippets showing Deny->Allow transition, and schedule a review.

sam: Note for postmortem: replication of keystore grants must be validated; least-privilege must include explicit resource ARNs per region.

rotator-bot: Incident resolved at 2025-03-17T00:34:12Z.
